study: Category willingness-to-pay, EU multi-chair dental clinics

items.text: How many chairs does your clinic operate?
In the last full month, how many hours did clinic staff spend on scheduling and billing admin?
How valuable would an automated scheduling and billing feature be to your clinic?
Which system do you currently use for scheduling and for billing, and how satisfied are you with it overall?
Our clinic always completes end-of-day reconciliation before closing.
What is the maximum monthly amount per chair your clinic would pay for a system that removed that admin time?
